definitions.explanation: A short note added at the end of a letter or email after the main text and signature.

examples.japanese: {追伸|ついしん}、お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧で。
⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{追伸|ついしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote a postscript at the end of the letter.

examples.japanese: {追伸|ついしん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{書|か}き{添|そ}えておいた。
examples.english: As a postscript, I also added the dates of next month's trip.

notes:
Written at the start of the added note, like English 'P.S.'; P.S. itself is also used in Japanese. In formal letters the added note is kept short.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追伸|ついしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a postscript
- {追伸|ついしん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a postscript
